payload_json.title: Reconstructing Complete Local Rings from Finite Quotients
payload_json.statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be complete local Noetherian rings with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m$ and $\mathfrak n$, respectively. If $A/\mathfrak m^r\cong B/\mathfrak n^r$ for every natural number $r$, must $A\cong B$?
